senses.gloss: m. (דקר; cmp. דּוּקְרָא) wickerwork, basket; jug inclosed in wickerwork.—Pl. דְּקוּרֵי, דְּקוּרַיָּא.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:6">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>כי ד׳ דהרפניא</he> (Ms. M. <he>כדקוראי</he>) of the size of the baskets of H.; <cite ref="Shabbat 127a:2">Sabb. 127ᵃ</cite> <he>כד׳ וכ׳</he> of the size of the jugs of H.—
Ḥull. 4ᵃ דקוריא דציפורי baskets with slaughtered birds (v. Tosaf. a. l.; Rashi: strings of birds, fr. דקר to perforate).
